TL; RD Stiamo espandendo il Corporate Innovation Team di Duferco: un team di ingegneri in rapida evoluzione che opera in un ambiente di startup, sostenuto dalla stabilità e dalla scala di un gruppo diversificato globale. Si lavorerà su una vasta gamma di progetti in settori come l'energia, il trading, la logistica, l'acciaio, l'assicurazione, lo sport e altri settori — non come consulente esterno, ma come parte del gruppo stesso, con la proprietà e la continuità di un team interno di prodotto e ingegneria. Costruirete piattaforme interne, strumenti abilitati all'IA, sistemi di automazione e infrastrutture di backend che rimuovono i colli di bottiglia operativi, migliorano il processo decisionale e creano leva in tutto il business. Informazioni sulla squadra Ci sediamo vicino a veri problemi di affari e abbiamo la libertà di prototipo e nave rapidamente. L'IA è già parte del nostro flusso di lavoro quotidiano, e ci aspettiamo che questo ruolo continui ad espandersi. Ci preoccupiamo di costruire bene le cose, sistemi di spedizione che creano leva, e lavorare con le persone che rendono il team migliore. Apprezziamo gli ingegneri che godono di proprietà, veloce iterazione, soluzione di problemi pragmatici e sviluppo assistita da AI. Cosa farai Progettazione e costruzione di sistemi che rendono l'organizzazione più veloce e intelligente:
• Servizi di backend e API, principalmente con servizi basati su FastAPI, Postgres e AWS
• Integrazioni tra sistemi interni e terzi, spesso dove la parte difficile è la comprensione del dominio, non il codice
• Automazione, agenti e strumenti operativi abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale
• Strumenti di ingegneria che migliora come costruiamo e spediamo
• Condutture di supporto dati e decisioni, incluse piattaforme di dati e strumenti di analisi interna Ti aiuterà a identificare opportunità, prototipo, nave, misura impatto, e iterare — non solo eseguire specifiche. Cosa offriamo
• Un ruolo ad alta autonomia con influenza diretta su ciò che viene costruito
• Moderni strumenti di ingegneria assistiti da AI e tempo per esplorare nuove tecnologie e approcci
• Un ambiente veloce e collaborativo con persone di talento e ambiziose
• Una vasta gamma di sfide tecniche e aziendali in diversi ambiti
• Compensazioni e vantaggi competitivi
• Ore lavorative flessibili e installazione ibrida Sei probabilmente un Fit Se
• Hai 5+ anni di costruzione di sistemi backend di produzione in Python, e potrebbe comodamente possedere un servizio FastAPI dalla progettazione alla distribuzione
• È possibile progettare un modello di dati da un problema di business disordinato — scegliendo le entità giuste, le relazioni e i trade-off — non solo implementare un altro
• Si effettuano scambi pragmatici tra velocità, qualità e manutenbilità, e può spiegare perché
• Si gode di lavoro di integrazione e prendere il tempo per capire un processo di business prima di modellarlo in codice
• Si utilizzano strumenti di codifica AI ogni giorno — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, o simili — e hanno opinioni su dove aiutano e dove non
• Sei a tuo agio con Postgres in produzione, tra cui progettazione di schemi, prestazioni di query e migrazioni, e avere esperienza con AWS L'esperienza con i magazzini di dati come Redshift, applicazioni LLM, quadri di agente, server MCP o domini operativi complessi è un vantaggio forte. Non avete bisogno di esperienza con ogni tecnologia che usiamo. Forte capacità di ingegneria, adattabilità e volontà di imparare la materia molto di più. Se questo suona come la soluzione giusta per voi, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi.
descriptionByLocale.en:
TL;DR
We are expanding Duferco’s Corporate Innovation Team: a fast-moving engineering team operating in a startup-like environment, backed by the stability and scale of a global diversified group.
You will work on a wide variety of projects across domains such as energy, trading, logistics, steel, insurance, sports, and other sectors — not as an external consultant, but as part of the group itself, with the ownership and continuity of an internal product and engineering team.
You will build internal platforms, AI-enabled tools, automation systems, and backend infrastructure that remove operational bottlenecks, improve decision-making, and create leverage across the business.
About the Team
We sit close to real business problems and have the freedom to prototype and ship quickly. AI is already part of our daily workflow, and we expect that role to keep expanding.
We care about building things well, shipping systems that create leverage, and working with people who make the team better.
We appreciate engineers who enjoy ownership, fast iteration, pragmatic problem solving, and AI-assisted development.
What You’ll Do
Design and build systems that make the organization faster and smarter:

• Backend services and APIs, mainly with FastAPI, Postgres, and AWS-based services

• Integrations across internal and third-party systems, often where the hard part is understanding the domain, not the code

• AI-enabled automation, agents, and operational tools

• Engineering tooling that improves how we build and ship

• Data and decision-support pipelines, including data platforms and internal analytics tooling

You’ll help identify opportunities, prototype, ship, measure impact, and iterate — not just execute specs.

What We Offer

• A high-autonomy role with direct influence on what gets built

• Modern AI-assisted engineering tools and time to explore new technologies and approaches

• A fast-moving, collaborative environment with talented and ambitious people

• A broad variety of technical and business challenges across different domains

• Competitive compensation and benefits

• Flexible working hours and hybrid work setup

You’re Probably a Fit If

• You have 5+ years building production backend systems in Python, and could comfortably own a FastAPI service from design to deployment

• You can design a data model from a messy business problem — choosing the right entities, relationships, and trade-offs — not just implement one someone else specified

• You make pragmatic trade-offs between speed, quality, and maintainability, and can explain why

• You enjoy integration work and take the time to understand a business process before modeling it in code

• You use AI coding tools daily — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar — and have opinions about where they help and where they don’t

• You’re comfortable with Postgres in production, including schema design, query performance, and migrations, and have experience with AWS

Experience with data warehouses such as Redshift, LLM applications, agent frameworks, MCP servers, or complex operational domains is a strong plus.
You do not need experience with every technology we use. Strong engineering ability, adaptability, and willingness to learn matter much more.
If this sounds like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you.

descriptionByLocale.en:
TL; DR
We are expanding Duferco’s Corporate Innovation Team: a fast-moving engineering team operating in a startup-like environment, backed by the stability and scale of a global diversified group.
We are looking for an engineering leader whose mission is to help evolve how software is built inside the organization through AI-assisted development, agentic coding workflows, and modern engineering practices.
This is not a traditional engineering management role focused mainly on delivery coordination. We are looking for someone who can establish and enforce high-leverage development workflows, improve engineering effectiveness, and help teams fully exploit modern AI coding tools and autonomous development systems.
You will work closely with engineers across projects and domains — helping shape coding standards, review processes, engineering tooling, development workflows, and AI-native software delivery practices.
About the Team
We sit close to real business problems and have the freedom to prototype and ship quickly. AI is already part of our daily workflow, and we expect that role to keep expanding.
We care about building things well, shipping systems that create leverage, and continuously improving how engineering work gets done.
We appreciate people who combine strong engineering judgment with pragmatism, curiosity, and a deep interest in how AI is changing software development itself.
What You’ll Do
Help transform and scale AI-assisted software development practices across the organization:

• Establish engineering best practices around AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows

• Drive adoption of modern AI development tooling such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, MCP-enabled workflows, autonomous agents, and related systems

• Improve development velocity and code quality through AI-assisted review, testing, refactoring, documentation, and automation practices

• Define and evolve engineering workflows for AI-native software delivery, including PR review standards, coding conventions, development environments, and collaboration patterns

• Mentor engineers on effective usage of AI coding tools, balancing speed, maintainability, reliability, and engineering judgment

• Evaluate emerging AI development paradigms and help the organization adopt practical approaches with real leverage

• Collaborate closely with engineering teams while remaining hands-on enough to understand workflow bottlenecks and opportunities firsthand

Help shape internal engineering tooling, automation systems, and developer productivity infrastructure.
What We Offer

• A high-autonomy role with significant influence on engineering practices and development culture

• The opportunity to help define how AI-assisted software engineering is adopted at scale inside the organization

• Modern AI-assisted engineering tools and freedom to experiment with new workflows and technologies

• A fast-moving, collaborative environment with talented and ambitious people

• A broad variety of technical and operational challenges across multiple industries and domains

• Competitive compensation and benefits

• Flexible working hours and hybrid work setup

You’re Probably a Fit If

• You have experience leading or mentoring software engineering teams in fast-moving environments

• You actively use AI coding tools daily — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, or similar — and have developed strong opinions about where they create leverage and where human judgment still matters most

• You think deeply about developer productivity, engineering workflows, code review quality, maintainability, and software delivery effectiveness

• You can balance pragmatism and engineering rigor without becoming process-heavy

• You are comfortable introducing new workflows and helping teams adopt them effectively

• You stay current with emerging development paradigms around LLMs, coding agents, autonomous workflows, MCP ecosystems, and AI-native engineering practices

• You are still technically strong enough to engage credibly with engineers and understand the realities of day-to-day software development

• You enjoy improving systems, workflows, and organizations — not just writing code

Experience with backend systems, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD systems, developer platforms, LLM applications, agent frameworks, or internal engineering tooling is a strong plus.
You do not need experience with every technology we use. Strong engineering judgment, adaptability, curiosity, and the ability to help teams evolve matter much more.
If this sounds like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you.

TL; RD Stiamo espandendo il Corporate Innovation Team di Duferco e stiamo cercando un Software Architetto pratico che possa modellare come progettiamo, costruiamo ed evolviamo il software interno in un ambiente di ingegneria AI-native. Potrai lavorare attraverso domini come l'energia, il trading, la logistica, l'acciaio, l'assicurazione, lo sport e altri settori, trasformando i problemi aziendali disordinati in sistemi ben strutturati che AI e umani possono implementare in modo sicuro e mantenere nel tempo. Definirai architetture pragmatiche, guiderai l'implementazione assistita dall'IA, stabilirai modelli di ingegneria e costruirai piattaforme interne, strumenti abilitati all'IA, sistemi di automazione e infrastrutture di backend che creano leva su tutto il gruppo. L'IA è già parte del nostro flusso di lavoro quotidiano, e ci aspettiamo che gli architetti ci aiutino ad usarlo con la disciplina, non solo la velocità. Ci preoccupiamo di costruire bene le cose: confini chiari, sistemi manutenbili, servizi osservabili, astrazioni utili e decisioni tecniche che si adattano al contesto aziendale. Apprezziamo le persone che combinano il pensiero architettonico con la consegna pratica, collaboriamo efficacemente con gli strumenti AI e aiutiamo il team a produrre software coerente, testabile, sicuro e facile da evolvere. descriptionByLocale.en:
TL;DR
We are expanding Duferco’s Corporate Innovation Team and are looking for a hands-on Software Architect who can shape how we design, build, and evolve internal software in an AI-native engineering environment.
You will work across domains such as energy, trading, logistics, steel, insurance, sports, and other sectors, turning messy business problems into well-structured systems that AI and humans can implement safely and maintain over time.
You will define pragmatic architectures, guide AI-assisted implementation, establish engineering patterns, and build internal platforms, AI-enabled tools, automation systems, and backend infrastructure that create leverage across the group.
About the Team
We sit close to real business problems and have the freedom to prototype and ship quickly. AI is already part of our daily workflow, and we expect architects to help us use it with discipline, not just speed.
We care about building things well: clear boundaries, maintainable systems, observable services, useful abstractions, and technical decisions that fit the business context.
We appreciate people who combine architectural thinking with hands-on delivery, collaborate effectively with AI tools, and help the team produce software that is coherent, testable, secure, and easy to evolve.
What You’ll Do
Shape the architecture of systems that make the organization faster and smarter:

• Design target architectures for internal platforms, backend services, APIs, data flows, and AI-enabled applications

• Translate ambiguous business processes into clear domain models, service boundaries, integration patterns, and implementation plans

• Guide AI-assisted implementation by breaking work into well-structured tasks, reviewing generated code, and ensuring architectural consistency

• Create reusable patterns, reference implementations, architectural decision records, and engineering guidelines for the team

• Work hands-on with FastAPI, Postgres, AWS-based services, data platforms, LLM applications, agents, and automation tools where useful

• Design integrations across internal and third-party systems with attention to reliability, security, data ownership, and maintainability

You will not just define diagrams or write specifications. You will help AI and humans implement the right architecture in real software, validate it in production, and improve it over time.
What We Offer

• A high-autonomy architecture role with direct influence on what gets built and how it gets built

• Modern AI-assisted engineering tools and time to explore new technologies, patterns, and development workflows

• A fast-moving, collaborative environment with talented and ambitious people

• A broad variety of technical and business challenges across different domains

• Competitive compensation and benefits

• Flexible working hours and hybrid work setup

You’re Probably a Fit If

• You have 5+ years building production software systems, with strong experience designing backend architectures and owning services from concept to deployment

• A Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent advanced technical experience may also be considered

• You can turn a messy business problem into a clean domain model, data model, service design, and implementation plan

• You make pragmatic architecture decisions, explain trade-offs, and adapt designs as reality changes

• You have strong Python backend experience and can work hands-on with FastAPI, Postgres, APIs, integrations, and AWS-based services

• You use AI coding tools daily — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar — and know how to guide them with clear architecture, constraints, tests, and review practices

• You care about software quality beyond the first implementation: modularity, observability, testing, security, migrations, operational reliability, and maintainability

Experience with LLM applications, agent frameworks, MCP servers, event-driven architectures, data warehouses such as Redshift, or complex operational domains is a strong plus.
You do not need experience with every technology we use. Strong architectural judgment, hands-on engineering ability, adaptability, and curiosity about AI-assisted software development matter much more.
If this sounds like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you.
